name: Microsoft for Education Daily
tldr: School IT can now lock Copilot Chat to Study and Learn, university leaders get a new AI guide, and Fabric adds a pay-as-you-go F0 capacity in preview.
window: Window: the 24 hours to 06:30 AEDT, Tue 24 Nov 2026 (Monday 23 Nov in the US), plus This-week items.
notes: This week: the Study & Learn lock and the Copilot Chat webinars come from Microsoft Education's post of 22 Nov (19:03 UTC, just before the window). The show called the lock coming soon on 3 Nov; this is the first word that it has fully rolled out.

Status: Insights Optimization in Foundry and Fabric's on-demand billing with F0 are in preview; the Wi-Fi driver move (2027) is as reported by Windows Latest; Sea of Remnants' closed beta runs 3-18 Dec for Xbox Insiders on Series X; the 84% figure is self-reported by University of South Carolina pilot users.
Screenshots are the publishers' public pages as captured on 24 Nov 2026; copyright remains with the publishers.

post.text:
ON YOUR TERMS. 🎓

The last 24h at Microsoft for education:
- School IT can lock Copilot Chat to Study and Learn (fully rolled out)
- A new AI guide for university leaders
- Llama on Windows: open models on your own PC
- Fabric's F0: no upfront capacity (preview)

stories.title: School IT can now lock Copilot Chat to just the Study and Learn agent
stories.summary: Microsoft Education says IT admins can now lock Copilot Chat so it only uses the Study & Learn agent. It calls this the number one request from K-12 schools globally, and says the feature is now fully rolled out.

stories.title: Copilot Chat webinars for school IT on 9 December, 13 January and 3 February
stories.summary: Microsoft Education is running three live webinars for IT admins on deploying and managing Copilot Chat in education, each at 8am Pacific and covering the same guidance: options for students 13+, CSV, SDS and PowerShell uploads, agents, licensing and security controls, and the Study & Learn lock.

stories.title: A new Microsoft guide helps university leaders move AI from pilots to impact
stories.summary: How to Unlock Intelligence in Higher Education is built around three conversations: where AI can advance university priorities, what information it needs to connect to, and how to build trust. Microsoft cites the University of South Carolina, where 84% of pilot users reported saving one to five hours a week.
stories.for: University leaders, from academic to IT and finance

stories.title: Run open AI models on your own PC with Llama on Windows
stories.summary: Llama on Windows, a free, open-source tray app from the Hugging Face and llama.cpp teams, finds, downloads and runs open models that fit your PC. Microsoft's .NET Blog shows how a C# app can call it through an OpenAI-format API on localhost, offline once a model is downloaded and with no API key.

stories.title: Microsoft Foundry can suggest fixes for problems your agent keeps repeating
stories.summary: In public preview, Insights Optimization takes recurring issues that agent insights finds and asks the agent optimizer to propose and test changes to the agent's instructions and tool descriptions. Nothing deploys automatically, but the tests run the agent's real tools, so Microsoft advises read-only access or test resources.
stories.for: University teams building agents for students and staff

stories.title: Fabric adds on-demand billing and an F0 capacity with no upfront charge
stories.summary: Microsoft Fabric's new F0 capacity has no upfront compute-capacity charge: workloads are billed only for what they use, at 1x to 3x the pay-as-you-go rate depending on the workload. Admins can set spend limits over a rolling 24 hours; at the limit, new jobs pause while running ones finish.

stories.title: November's Windows hotpatch can break printing on PCs running Forcepoint DLP
stories.summary: Microsoft confirmed that after the November 2026 Windows 11 hotpatch (KB5132043), PCs running the Forcepoint DLP Endpoint Agent may find the print option greyed out or get errors, because the Print Spooler fails to start. It affects Windows 11 24H2 and later on hotpatched devices only; there's no fix yet, but Forcepoint has a workaround.

stories.title: Six Azure AI Content Safety preview features retire on 30 April 2027
stories.summary: Retiring: Analyze Multimodal, rapid custom categories, connected and disconnected containers, the embedded Content Safety SDK, and groundedness detection in Azure AI Content Safety and Azure OpenAI. Microsoft says to review the recommended alternatives and plan your migration before the date.
stories.for: University teams filtering student-facing AI apps

stories.title: Windows is reportedly moving Wi-Fi drivers out of the kernel in 2027
stories.summary: Windows Latest reports that Microsoft plans to move Wi-Fi drivers from the Windows kernel into user mode in 2027, under its Driver Quality Initiative, so a faulty Wi-Fi driver is less able to crash the whole PC. A Microsoft product manager said at Ignite that the Wi-Fi work will be released in 2027.

stories.title: Sea of Remnants opens a closed beta on Xbox Series X from 3 December
stories.summary: Sea of Remnants, a free-to-play turn-based roguelike in a puppetfolk world, runs its Dawnbreaker closed beta for Xbox Insiders on Series X from 3 to 18 December (US time). Places are limited: grab a launch-day spot through the Xbox Insider Hub or enter the access draw.
